references.title: Comparison of 5 day embryo transfer with 2-3 day transfer in patients with previous in vitro fertilization failure
references.original-title: Comparison of 5 day embryo transfer with 2-3 day transfer in patients who failed to conceive in two or more day 2-3 embryo transfer cycle in Royan Institute

characteristics.name: Methods
characteristics.value:
Prospective randomised clinical trial divided into two groups. Random permuted blocks with a block size of 4 was used and complete allocation concealment

Single-blind (outcomes assessor)

characteristics.name: Participants
characteristics.value:
200 participants with infertility

Inclusion criteria: two or more previous failed IVF/ICSI cycles; 18 to 40 years

characteristics.name: Interventions
characteristics.value:
Experimental: day 5 embryo transfer group

Other group (day 2-3) not described (only mentioned in the title and objectives)

characteristics.name: Outcomes
characteristics.value: Clinical pregnancy rate; live birth rate; implantation rate; miscarriage rate
